g.text: 充电桩插枪/拔枪/选择充电桩时序图
选择充电桩，点击"模拟插枪"
使用设备专用 JWT Token
HTTP 403 Forbidden {error: "需要充电桩设备权限"}
SELECT id, status, online_status, occupied_by FROM chargers WHERE id = ? -- PreparedStatement
UPDATE chargers SET occupied_by = ?, occupied_at = now(), status = 'idle'
WHERE id = ? AND status = 'idle' AND occupied_by IS NULL -- 乐观锁
INSERT INTO audit_logs (actor_id, actor_type, action, resource, resource_id)
显示含 chargerId 的二维码
HTTP 409 Conflict {error: "会话已过期或无效，请重新扫码"}
SELECT id, status, online_status FROM chargers WHERE id = ? -- PreparedStatement
选择成功 {chargerId, chargerCode, stationId, type}
显示充电桩信息，提示点击启动充电
SELECT id, status FROM chargers WHERE id = ? -- PreparedStatement
SELECT * FROM charge_records WHERE charger_id = ? AND status = 'processing' -- 进行中的充电记录
[遍历每个进行中的充电记录]
UPDATE charge_records SET end_time=now(), energy_kwh=?, fee=?, status='completed', deduction_status='paid' WHERE id = ?
UPDATE users SET balance = balance - ? WHERE id = ? AND balance >= ?
INSERT INTO payments (id, user_id, charge_record_id, method, amount, status) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'auto_deduct', ?, 'success')
INSERT INTO audit_logs (actor_id, actor_type, action, resource, resource_id) VALUES (?, 'system', 'STOP_CHARGE', 'charge_record', ?)
UPDATE charge_records SET end_time=now(), energy_kwh=?, fee=?, status='completed', deduction_status='arrears' WHERE id = ?
UPDATE users SET frozen_until = now() + INTERVAL '30 days' WHERE id = ?
INSERT INTO audit_logs (actor_id, actor_type, action, resource, resource_id) VALUES (?, 'system', 'CHARGE_ARREARS', 'charge_record', ?)
UPDATE chargers SET status = 'idle', occupied_by = NULL, occupied_at = NULL WHERE id = ? -- 释放占用锁并恢复空闲
INSERT INTO audit_logs (actor_id, actor_type, action, resource, resource_id) VALUES (?, 'device', 'UNPLUG', 'charger', ?)
